noCanonicalWrites: No Payload, localStorage, translation, canonical sidecar, saved geometry, original PDF, or other page writes are allowed. Human vote storage is a separate future V2 namespace only after the UI exists; no votes are present now.
eligibility: All selected units were not in the V1 experiment and were English fallback in the PT-BR Viewer and had no page-14 translation records in the read-only API query.

conditions.A: Same model/context window/effort defaults and common materials. No skill or casebook body is to be opened. Generate each unit with up to 2 revision attempts and return final candidate plus semantic/style mapping and blocker declaration.
conditions.B: Same model/context window/effort defaults and same common materials, plus exactly the three named editorial skill files and editorial-casebook.md. Same per-unit limit: one initial draft and at most 2 revision attempts.

generationLimits.commonPrompt: Same instruction base, eight units, source/context packet, geometry, semantic checklist, output JSON schema, and one initial draft plus up to two revisions per unit.
generationLimits.model: Both agents inherit the same current Codex model/configuration; no model override will be used.
generationLimits.contextIsolation: Two separately spawned subagent contexts with fork_turns=none; outputs will be returned directly and kept out of shared files until each condition is frozen.
generationLimits.skillExposureCaveat: The Codex environment presents the skill catalog metadata (names/descriptions) globally. Skill bodies are not automatically loaded. A will be explicitly told not to open or apply the three files or casebook; B is required to read them.

generationRecord.conditionA: Separate subagent with fork_turns=none; used common resources only and did not read skill/casebook bodies or other condition output.
generationRecord.conditionB: Separate subagent with fork_turns=none; used the same common resources plus exactly the three named skill files and the casebook; did not read A output.
generationRecord.modelLimit: Both report GPT-6 family under the same inherited runtime; exact model identifier, snapshot, reasoning settings, and token consumption are not exposed for verification.
generationRecord.contaminationLimit: The global Codex skill catalog exposes skill names and short descriptions to all contexts. Condition A was instructed not to open/apply the skill bodies or casebook; global metadata exposure cannot be removed in this runtime.
generationRecord.workbookLimit: Both conditions used the same workbook excerpts embedded in the common packet. The XLSX was not reopened inside either agent context.

common.externalGuideAuthority: The workbook was supplied by the user; it is the Adventure Book team guide and only comparative context. PDF and project glossary take precedence for the Rulebook. Workbook style guidance must not override source styling.

unitSelection.sourceText: 1.	PREPARE PHASE: Each Adventurer removes their Used tokens from their Per Encounter Abilities and Un-Exhausts all cards. All Defeated Adventurers or Adventurers with more Damage tokens than half of their max HP remove Damage tokens until they have Damage tokens equal to half of their max HP. All Effect tokens are removed, and each Adventurer sets their Stamina Points (SP) to their Stamina Point Recovery Value (usually 3).
